test_title: PYST 46: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select an appropriate title for the passage.

options.text: Levels of Stress in Different Age Groups

solution:
The correct answer is stress and its consequences.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Refer to the opening line of the passage: While there is no denying that the world loves a winner, it is important that you recognise the signs of stress in your behaviour and be healthy enough to enjoy your success.
 
• Refer to the concluding line of the passage: Periodic mood shifts also indicate the stress status of the students, executives, and professionals.
 
• Throughout the passage, the writer talks about stress, reason of **stress** and consequences of stress.
 
• Thus, the **most suitable title** for the passage is 'stress and its consequences'.
 
• Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.
